title: SPEC A implementation: config staging/live promotion

completion_criteria.text: The seven unit PRs are all on main: five merged into stack parents rather than main and were re-integrated bottom-up through two further pr.mjs PRs, verified by merge-base ancestry.
The three release-rejecting defects are fixed and the validator hardened through two reviews, including a CRITICAL code-execution path in the python checker, shipped as merged PR #54.
SPEC A section 7's five cutover preconditions are all closed and verified, with the *session* gitignore pattern narrowed BEFORE the hook file it hides is adopted.
The promote verb is implemented with pre-swap validation, rollback by rename, and the LIVE receipt, and the bootstrap resolves outside releases/.
SessionStart and Stop converge hooks are registered, and a drift report reaches session context when live differs from main.
The settings.json ownership manifest and the separate capture verb are implemented, with unknown keys defaulting to LIVE WINS and flagged rather than dropped.
The cutover runs serially in a session doing nothing else: the first release is built and validated with zero live change, then every entry link is swapped in one pass.
All 10 of SPEC A's acceptance criteria pass, with criterion 10 verified by diffing the live tree against the release rather than asserted.
Every unit ships through a PR opened by pr.mjs pr-create, stacked with --base <parent-branch> where one change blocks another.

spine.active_goal: Build the cutover unit, ship it as one PR, then perform the live cutover as the session's last act.
spine.next_step: START HERE FRESH per 0289: build first, swap LAST, one session. Read 0286, 0287, 0288, 0289. Build the cutover verb, idempotent and reversible: relink 8 depth-1 entries to current/; collapse hooks/ and rules/ after disposing of the two stale graphify-out dirs and the live context7.md; move notes/ to local/ per 0276. Add the guard repo_root fix, the PROBE_FILES change, the grant withdrawal, an install-bootstrap re-run. ONE PR via pr.mjs. Then rehearse per 0281, register converge, swap.
spine.last_session: Measured the swap inventory 0286 called unimplemented; found three live leftovers blocking the hooks and rules collapse, and no disposition for notes/; shipped no code.

open_risks.text: The single npm test failure is environmental, not a regression — protect-claude-config.test.mjs asserts ~/.claude/settings.json is a symlink when it is a real file, and it skips on CI runners, so green CI plus this one local failure is the expected reading.
Never run git checkout main in the primary checkout — live global config is symlinked into that working tree, so switching branches hot-swaps every skill and hook under every running session
Serialize every write to a live-linked path, not just the cutover — the converge registration reaches running sessions through the hook symlinks, so a half-saved file breaks every session instantly
The promote verb still has no production caller until the converge hooks are registered live — a faithful scratch rehearsal exercises it end to end, but nothing runs it in anger
Enumerate every code path an invariant covers before dispatching a fix round — an earlier round satisfied containment for hook paths and missed the JSON scan beside it, which cost a fourth round

Dispose of the two stale graphify-out directories and the live context7.md before collapsing hooks and rules — they are real entries inside directories the cutover turns into symlinks, so the collapse either fails or silently discards them

Move the five files in the checkout's untracked notes directory to live-only local/ before touching the notes symlink — repointing it strands them and deleting it destroys them, and two hold the confidential material 0276 refused to publish

Expect the cutover to move live content from a branch 64 commits behind main, not merely change a level of indirection — the primary checkout serves live config and sits on another thread's branch with uncommitted edits
Get a ruling on the graphify report before the swap — collapsing rules/ stops it being loaded as a global instruction file in every session, and the user has not ruled on that

Build the entry-link swap before trusting any cutover — promote moves the current pointer but nothing creates the ten entry links, so a run today writes a LIVE receipt claiming a swap that never happened

Re-measure the live symlink census before the swap — an earlier count said 38 including debug/, this session measured 37, and the swap must be driven by a count taken at cutover time rather than either stale figure

Repoint protect-claude-config.sh at the LIVE receipt's repo_root in the cutover change — it finds the checkout by realpath, which after cutover lands inside a release rather than a git worktree, so the guard drops to a weaker textual match

Withdraw the live ln -sfn grant through the mechanism 0288 adopted — permissions.allow is unioned, so without an active subtraction the wrong non-atomic link form survives every future promotion, not just the first
Re-run the 0281 rehearsal against merged main before any live write — the green rehearsal validated 1e84dd1, which is no longer the sha that will ship

Close every other claude session before the pointer swap — SPEC section 9 records that whether a swap reaches an already-running session is unmeasured, so any open session is an uncontrolled experiment on global config
Exclude local/ and notes from acceptance criterion 10's diff — SPEC section 2 is stale against 0276 and still draws eleven entry links including notes, so a literal diff fails for the wrong reason

key_decisions.title: SPEC A is implemented and shipped by a dedicated small dynamic workflow, with stacked PRs for blocking changes
The workflow fan-out boundary is any write to a live-linked path, not the cutover alone
Three plans are scrubbed at source; notes/ is reclassified live-only and never enters a release
chore/config-drift is the stack root and the inert basis lands before SPEC A's units
The inert basis ships as one atomic change carrying its evaluator, never as registry data alone
The inert basis leaves this phase's critical path; it buys SPEC A's PRs nothing and is under an open BLOCK
Every cutover attempt rehearses the real promote verb against a scratch config root before any live write
Release validation fails closed on any registered hook it cannot verify
Three residual validator weaknesses are disclosed in the invariant record rather than fixed
A test that spawns a real interpreter is either availability-guarded or converted to assert checker selection
The bootstrap installs as a pinned copy of an import-derived closure, not a symlink or a hardcoded file list
The entry-link swap ships as a tested cutover verb, bundled with the guard fix and the grant correction, before any live write
settings.json stays a real live file and the guard's probe test is what changes
The stale ln -sfn grant is withdrawn by promotion, not merely refused by capture
One fresh session builds the cutover unit and then performs the live cutover as its last act
The cutover verb moves real content aside instead of deleting it, which defers the graphify-report ruling rather than forcing it
Promotion applies the reconciled settings.json to live, because the withdrawal set 0288 adopted is inert without it
The live swap moves to a dedicated session, honoring SPEC section 7 substance over 0289 session count
